name: command_batch
title: Command batch
description: Run several engine commands in one call, in order (fewer round trips). Returns {completed, failed, results:[{ok, result|error}]}; stops at the first error unless stop_on_error is false. Not an atomic transaction: earlier successful steps stay applied (no rollback).

steps.description:
Commands to run in order: `[{"id": "layer.new.layer", "params": {"name": "Ink"}}, …]`. A
step with `"wait": false` starts a long command as a background job (its result is
`{"job": id}`, as in `command_run`); later steps that edit the same document fail until
the job ends.

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failing step (default true).

name: command_list
title: Command list
description: List engine commands. Returns a JSON array (no wrapper object) of {id, label, menu: [path], shortcut: string|null, params: doc string, enabled: bool, disabledReason: string|null, needsDocument: bool}. `disabledReason` says why a command is off (null when enabled); `needsDocument` is true when it is off because no document is open: create or open one first (doc_new, doc_open).

enabled_only.description: Only commands that can run right now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id, label or keywords contain this text (case-insensitive).

name: command_run
title: Command run
description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Returns the command's JSON result. Long commands (filters, Content-Aware Fill/Scale, Photomerge, brush import) wait to finish unless `wait` is false: then they run as a background job and the result is {job: id} (see jobs_list, jobs_cancel).

params.description: Command parameters as a JSON object (see the `params` doc in `command_list`).

wait.description:
Wait for a long command (filters, Content-Aware Fill, Photomerge, …) to finish (default
true). With false it runs as a background job and the result is `{"job": id}`: poll it
with `jobs_list`, stop it with `jobs_cancel`.

name: control_call
title: Control call
description: Bridge mode: call any control-protocol method (docs/control-protocol.md) with raw params.

name: doc_close
title: Doc close
description: Close a document (default: the active one) without saving.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

name: doc_export
title: Doc export
description: Export the document to another format (same as doc_save with an explicit path/format).

ddsCompression.description:
DDS: "none" (uncompressed, the default), "bc1" (DXT1: alpha on or off), "bc2" (DXT3) or
"bc3" (DXT5).

ddsMipmaps.description: DDS: also write the full mip chain, each level a box filter of the one above.

dpxBits.description: DPX: 8, 10, 12 or 16 bits per sample. Unset: 8 for an 8-bit document, else 16.

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Target beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP quality 1..100. A WebP saved with a quality is lossy; without one it is lossless.

tgaBits.description:
TGA: 24 or 32 bits per pixel. 32 writes the alpha channel (or else the transparency) as the
alpha, 24 none. Unset: 32 with an alpha channel or transparency, else 24.

tiffLayers.description: TIFF: keep the layers (Photoshop layer data). Off by default: a flat TIFF.

name: doc_export_data_sets
title: Doc export data sets
description: Export every data set of the document as its own flattened file beneath the write root (the capability-scoped Export Data Sets). The batch is planned first, so colliding filenames are refused before any file is written.

data_sets.description: Only these data sets, by name; default every one of them.

dir.description: Directory beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

name: doc_export_layers
title: Doc export layers
description: Export top-level layers as files (groups merged). Returns files and skipped: [{layer, name, reason}] for hidden layers (visible_only) and adjustments with no pixels of their own. Workspace exports resolve beneath the write root, also return count of written files, and reject existing files instead of overwriting them. Trusted-local/bridge exports use the engine command's file access policy.

dir.description: Directory beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

quality.description: Encoder quality, 0..12, for the formats that take one.

visible_only.description: Export only the layers that are visible (default true).

name: doc_import_data_sets
title: Doc import data sets
description: Import a data set CSV from the read root into the document (the capability-scoped Import Variable Data Sets).

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

name: doc_inspect
title: Doc inspect
description: Document state as JSON: layer tree (top to bottom), history, selection, active layer.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

name: doc_new
title: Doc new
description: Create a new document (defaults: 1920x1080 RGB 8-bit white).

name: doc_open
title: Doc open
description: Open an image or document file and make it active. Returns index, size and import warnings.

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

name: doc_place
title: Doc place
description: Place a file into the document as a Smart Object layer (Place Embedded), reading `path` beneath the read root. `scale` (percent), `fit` and `center` are the command's own.

center.description: Centre of the placed layer, in document pixels.

fit.description: Place at a centred size instead of a scaled one.

index.description: Document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

scale.description: Scale as a percentage; defaults to fitting a file larger than the canvas.

name: doc_render_preview
title: Doc render preview
description: Render the flattened document and return it as a PNG image (bridge mode: window screenshot).

index.description:
Headless mode only: document index (default: the active document).
Bridge previews capture the app window and reject `index`.

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

name: doc_replace_smart_object
title: Doc replace smart object
description: Replace a Smart Object's contents with the file at `path` beneath the read root, keeping its transform and filters (the capability-scoped Replace Contents). `layer` is the Smart Object's id or name (default: the active layer).

index.description:
Headless mode only: document index from `session_list` (default: the active document).
Bridge mode rejects `index`.

layer.description: The Smart Object layer: an id or a name (default: the active layer).

path.description: Path beneath the configured automation read root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.

name: doc_save
title: Doc save
description: Save the document. `.pcraft` is the lossless native format (incremental); other extensions (psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …) export. Without `path` only a PSD, PSB or .pcraft document is written back to its own         file. Returns warnings about anything the format cannot hold.

ddsCompression.description:
DDS: "none" (uncompressed, the default), "bc1" (DXT1: alpha on or off), "bc2" (DXT3) or
"bc3" (DXT5).

ddsMipmaps.description: DDS: also write the full mip chain, each level a box filter of the one above.

dpxBits.description: DPX: 8, 10, 12 or 16 bits per sample. Unset: 8 for an 8-bit document, else 16.

format.description: Format override as an extension (pcraft, psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …).

path.description:
Target beneath the configured automation write root: relative (forward slashes) or absolute.
The extension selects the format. Omit to write back to the document's own file, which
works only for a PSD, PSB or .pcraft file kept in its own format; any other save needs
`path`, so a flattened or converted copy never replaces the opened file.

quality.description: JPEG or WebP quality 1..100. A WebP saved with a quality is lossy; without one it is lossless.

tgaBits.description:
TGA: 24 or 32 bits per pixel. 32 writes the alpha channel (or else the transparency) as the
alpha, 24 none. Unset: 32 with an alpha channel or transparency, else 24.

tiffLayers.description: TIFF: keep the layers (Photoshop layer data). Off by default: a flat TIFF.

name: doc_select
title: Doc select
description: Make the document at `index` active.

name: jobs_cancel
title: Jobs cancel
description: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.

job.description: The job id from `command_run` / `jobs_list` (omit to cancel every running job).

name: jobs_list
title: Jobs list
description: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.

name: render_preview
title: Render preview
description: Render a bounded flattened PNG preview (bridge mode: app window screenshot).

index.description:
Headless mode only: document index (default: the active document).
Bridge previews capture the app window and reject `index`.

max_side.description:
Longest side of a headless preview (default 1024, maximum 2048).
Zero requests full size within that ceiling. Bridge mode returns the window screenshot.

name: session_list
title: Session list
description: List open documents (index, name, size, dirty) and the active index.

name: ui_inspect
title: Ui inspect
description: Bridge mode: full UI state of the live app (tool, panels, views, dialogs, windows). For the menu tree, call `control_call` with method `ui.menu.list`.

name: ui_menu_invoke
title: Ui menu invoke
description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id.

name: ui_pointer
title: Ui pointer
description: Bridge mode: send pointer events (document coordinates) to the active tool; with a Color Picker open they sample the image into it instead.

button.description:
Mouse button: `left` (default), or `right` / `secondary`: with the Move tool or
`{"command":true}` it opens the canvas layer menu, with a painting tool the Brush Preset
picker.

items.description: One `ui_pointer` event, for the tool schema only: events are forwarded to `ui.pointer` as JSON.

tiltX.description: A simulated pen's tilt, as a stylus reports it.

name: ui_screenshot
title: Ui screenshot
description: Bridge mode: screenshot of the live app window as PNG.

max_side.description:
Downscale the window screenshot to this longest side (maximum 2048).
Omit or pass zero to keep the original size.

name: ui_set
title: Ui set
description: Bridge mode: change UI state (tool, panels, dock, zoom, center, fit, theme, brush settings; see `fields`). Unknown fields are an error.

fields.description:
Fields for the control method `ui.set`: tool, panels, dock, dockTabs, dockWidth, colorPanel
({background: bool} picks which swatch the Color panel edits), maskTarget,
vectorMaskTarget, filterMaskTarget (paint the active smart object's filter mask), selectionMode, zoom, center, rotation (view angle in degrees), fit, theme (pro, proMedium, studio,
studioLight, classic, solarizedDark, adwaita, adwaitaDark, breezeLight, breezeDark, softLight, softDark), brushSection, brushTab,
brushesView, brushPicker ([x, y] opens the Brush Preset picker there, null closes it),
brushPickerName, brushPickerStroke, brushPickerTip (the picker card's parts, at least one
on), brushPickerScale (the picker footer's card-scale slider, 0.15 to 2, 1 the standard),
brushSize, gradientBlendMode
(a blend mode name, for the Gradient tool), gradientClassic (bool), eyedropperSampleSize
("point" or 1, 3, 5, 11, 31, 51, 101), eyedropperSample (current, currentAndBelow, all,
allNoAdjustments, currentAndBelowNoAdjustments), eyedropperRing (bool), cropOverlay (thirds,
grid, diagonal, triangle, goldenRatio, goldenSpiral), cropOverlayShow (auto, always, never),
cropOverlayOrientation (0..3), cropShield (an object patching show_cropped_area, enabled,
color ("matchCanvas" or "custom"), custom_color ([r, g, b]), opacity (0..100),
auto_adjust, classic_mode and auto_center_preview), cropFill (background or contentAware,
the Crop tool's Fill), shapeStroke (an object patching width, align, cap, join, miterLimit,
dashes, dashOffset and opacity; null disables the stroke). Shape stroke fields use
`shape.edit` names and units; colour comes from `tools.setColors`. camTransformOnDrop (bool,
the Content-Aware Move tool's Transform On Drop). tileGrid (bool, a developer overlay of the
active layer's storage tiles). layerFilter (an object patching by ("kind", "name" or
"mode"), kinds (a list of layer kinds), name (matches part of the layer name) and mode (a
blend mode name) for the Layers panel filter). strokeTrace (true, false, "stderr" or "off":
the stroke latency trace at runtime; a CSV file is set at launch with --stroke-trace, not
over this channel). updatesOpen (bool, the Help › Check for Updates window).
histogramPanel (an object patching view ("compact", "expanded" or "allChannels"), channel
("composite", "red", "green", "blue", "cyan", "magenta", "yellow", "black", "a", "b",
"luminosity" or "colors"), showChannelsInColor, showStatistics and source ("entireImage",
"selectedLayer" or "adjustmentComposite") for the Histogram panel), histogramRange ([from,
to] levels 0..255 whose Count and Percentile the panel shows, or null) and histogramRefresh
(true: an Uncached Refresh); `ui.inspect` reports them and the statistics under
`histogram`. Other fields are an error.
